title: FIDEOS a high-resolution echelle spectrograph for the ESO 1 m telescope
what_was_studied: Proposed fibre feed, environmental control and calibration architecture
numerical_result: The design specified resolving power near 42000 over 400 to 680 nm using separate science and calibration fibres
remaining_question: Pre-installation specifications require on-sky validation and differ from the final delivered coverage

title: Precision stellar radial velocity measurements with FIDEOS
what_was_studied: Commissioning and early science at the ESO 1 m telescope
numerical_result: The paper reports approximately 8 m/s stability over several consecutive nights
remaining_question: Seasonal stability and target-dependent terms remain unmeasured in that result

title: CERES automated routines for echelle spectra
what_was_studied: Automated extraction, wavelength calibration and RV estimation for FIDEOS and other instruments
numerical_result: CERES provides a common modular reduction framework for thirteen named spectrographs
remaining_question: Instrument-specific validation remains necessary after shared processing

title: FIDEOS public instrument page
what_was_studied: Installation, coverage, resolving power and public stability summary
numerical_result: ESO reports 420 to 800 nm, resolving power near 43000 and stability just below 30 km/h over consecutive nights
remaining_question: The page does not establish current observing availability or a multi-year floor
